routes.title: Straight into your degree with the HSC
routes.text: UTM and UKM take the HSC straight into a degree, and Sunway may; check your grades against each university's rule.

routes.title: Foundation year first
routes.text: The Bangladesh HSC is not on Monash Malaysia's list of commonly accepted qualifications, so this route plans a foundation year first. Monash also offers its own diploma as a way in.

routes.title: Straight into your degree
routes.text: A level students can apply for the degree directly. Pathway uses the month classes begin.

applyBefore.label: When to apply
applyBefore.text: Malaysian admission is rolling, so Pathway plans to apply at least 4 months before the start, leaving time for the offer, up to 8 weeks for the student pass, the visa and travel.

arriveSpare.label: Arriving before classes
arriveSpare.text: Pathway plans to have you there a week before your start month, for registration.

steps.title: Apply to your university
steps.text: Each university sets its own application and acceptance dates for every intake. Apply early, because the student pass waits for your offer.

taskWhen.task: Apply for the Monash University Foundation Year at Sunway College
Apply to Monash University Malaysia or your chosen university
Apply to Universiti Teknologi Malaysia or your chosen university

textWhen.text: Monash sets an application deadline for each intake, about ten weeks before classes begin. The source panel shows this year's dates.
UTM asks for your final results before the intake, so Pathway plans your application after your HSC results.

steps.title: Your student pass is approved
steps.text: Your university applies to EMGS for you. Once approved, you receive a Visa Approval Letter.
tasks: Pay the EMGS fees your university asks for

steps.title: Get your single-entry visa online
steps.text: Apply online through Malaysia's eVISA system, from Bangladesh, after your eVAL arrives. The eVAL is valid for 6 months, so travel before it expires. You do not apply at the High Commission.

steps.title: Travel to Malaysia
steps.text: Pathway uses the first day of your start month until you enter your university's exact date.
tasks: Fill in the Malaysia Digital Arrival Card in the three days before you arrive

steps.title: Medical screening in Malaysia
steps.text: Within 7 days of arriving, at an EMGS panel clinic, or at your university's own clinic at a public university, before your student pass goes into your passport.

shaping.tierReach: Your universities are mostly very competitive. Each university has its own application, so Pathway suggests 3 to 5.
shaping.tierBalanced: Your universities are a balanced mix. Each university has its own application, so Pathway suggests 3 to 5.
shaping.tierSafe: Your universities are mostly less competitive. Each university has its own application, so Pathway suggests 3 to 5.
shaping.passportValid: You have a valid passport. For Malaysia it must stay valid for at least 18 months after you start, so check its expiry date.
shaping.englishNotAccepted: The Duolingo English Test does not count for the Malaysian student pass. So preparation for {test} and a test are planned.
